output.notes: Described the headline standard-parameterization (SP) Cerebras-GPT family (released 111M-13B); the IR attributes use the primary 111M config. The muP variants (111M-2.7B) instead multiply the embedding output by m_emb=10, divide the output logits by m_width, and scale attention by 1/d_head. These muP changes are not included in the IR. n_heads is not tabulated; the FLOPs code gives num_heads = d_model // key_size, so the 111M model would have 12 heads, but that number is not written in the paper. Tied embeddings and the absence of an output bias are inferred from the parameter-count formula, which has no separate unembedding term. The muP text also mentions shared embedding and output weights. Pre-LN placement is inherited from the stated 'standard GPT-2 transformer block'. The GELU form (exact or tanh) and the LayerNorm eps are not stated.
